meanings.en: in a way that shows you feel sorry for something you have done
meanings.exampleEn: He looked at her repentantly and apologized for his harsh words.
meanings.exampleTr: Ona pişmanlıkla baktı ve sert sözleri için özür diledi.

meanings.en: in a cruel way without feeling sorry, or without stopping
meanings.exampleEn: The army advanced remorselessly toward the capital.
meanings.exampleTr: Ordu başkente doğru acımasızca ilerledi.

meanings.en: without showing regret or pity
meanings.exampleEn: She criticized his work remorselessly.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun çalışmasını vicdansızca eleştirdi.

meanings.en: to fail to pay a debt or keep a promise
meanings.exampleEn: He welshed on the bet and never paid what he owed.
meanings.exampleTr: Bahsi ödemekten kaytardı ve borcunu asla ödemedi.

meanings.en: payment or action to correct something wrong or unfair
meanings.exampleEn: Customers can seek redress through the courts.
meanings.exampleTr: Müşteriler mahkemeler aracılığıyla telafi arayabilir.

meanings.en: to correct something that is unfair or wrong
meanings.exampleEn: The government promised to redress the injustices of the past.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükümet geçmişin adaletsizliklerini gidermeye söz verdi.

meanings.en: protection against or compensation for loss or damage
meanings.exampleEn: The contract includes an indemnity clause protecting the buyer.
meanings.exampleTr: Sözleşme, alıcıyı koruyan bir tazminat maddesi içeriyor.

meanings.en: the clever or humorous use of words, especially with double meanings
meanings.exampleEn: The poem is full of clever wordplay and puns.
meanings.exampleTr: Şiir zekice kelime oyunları ve cinaslarla dolu.

meanings.en: looking pale, tired, or worried
meanings.exampleEn: Her face was pale and drawn after the long illness.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun hastalıktan sonra yüzü solgun ve bitkindi.

meanings.en: able to be exchanged for something else
meanings.exampleEn: The gift voucher is exchangeable for any product in the store.
meanings.exampleTr: Hediye çeki mağazadaki herhangi bir ürünle değiştirilebilir.

meanings.tr: yerine başka bir şey konabilir, ikame edilebilir
meanings.en: able to be replaced by something else that serves the same purpose
meanings.exampleEn: In economics, two goods are substitutable if one can replace the other.
meanings.exampleTr: Ekonomide, biri diğerinin yerini alabiliyorsa iki mal ikame edilebilirdir.

meanings.en: too special or valuable to be replaced by anything else
meanings.exampleEn: These ancient manuscripts are irreplaceable treasures.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu antik el yazmaları yeri doldurulamaz hazinelerdir.

meanings.en: to fill something again after it has been emptied
meanings.exampleEn: The waiter came over to refill our glasses.
meanings.exampleTr: Garson bardaklarımızı yeniden doldurmak için geldi.

meanings.en: an amount that fills something again
meanings.exampleEn: Coffee refills are free at this café.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu kafede kahve tazelemeleri ücretsizdir.

meanings.en: to fill up a supply of something again
meanings.exampleEn: The store needs to restock its shelves before the weekend.
meanings.exampleTr: Mağazanın hafta sonundan önce raflarını yeniden doldurması gerekiyor.

meanings.en: to refuse an offer or request in an unfriendly way
meanings.exampleEn: She rebuffed all his attempts to apologize.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun tüm özür dileme çabalarını geri çevirdi.

meanings.en: an unkind refusal of an offer or request
meanings.exampleEn: His proposal met with a sharp rebuff.
meanings.exampleTr: Teklifi sert bir retle karşılandı.

meanings.en: a district or area of a town, or the people who live there
meanings.exampleEn: We moved to a quiet neighbourhood near the park.
meanings.exampleTr: Parkın yakınındaki sakin bir mahalleye taşındık.

meanings.en: the quality of being strong and not easily damaged or broken
meanings.exampleEn: The material is prized for its toughness and durability.
meanings.exampleTr: Malzeme sağlamlığı ve dayanıklılığı nedeniyle değer görüyor.

meanings.en: the quality of being strong-willed or determined
meanings.exampleEn: Mental toughness is essential for elite athletes.
meanings.exampleTr: Zihinsel dayanıklılık seçkin sporcular için şarttır.

meanings.en: done or said in a strong and clear way that leaves no doubt
meanings.exampleEn: She was emphatic that she would not change her mind.
meanings.exampleTr: Fikrini değiştirmeyeceği konusunda kesindi.

meanings.en: showing a clear and decisive result
meanings.exampleEn: The team won an emphatic victory over their rivals.
meanings.exampleTr: Takım rakiplerine karşı ezici bir galibiyet aldı.

meanings.en: showing respect and politeness toward someone, often of higher rank
meanings.exampleEn: He spoke in a deferential tone to his superiors.
meanings.exampleTr: Üstlerine saygılı bir tonda konuştu.

meanings.en: in a way that shows a lack of respect
meanings.exampleEn: He behaved disrespectfully toward his teachers.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmenlerine karşı saygısızca davrandı.

meanings.en: the act of returning someone to a previous position or something to a previous state
meanings.exampleEn: The union demanded the reinstatement of the dismissed workers.
meanings.exampleTr: Sendika işten çıkarılan işçilerin işe iadesini talep etti.

meanings.en: limiting or restricting what someone can do
meanings.exampleEn: He found the strict rules too constraining.
meanings.exampleTr: Katı kuralları fazla kısıtlayıcı buldu.

meanings.en: to lift, pull, or throw something heavy with great effort
meanings.exampleEn: They heaved the heavy crate onto the truck.
meanings.exampleTr: Ağır sandığı güçlükle kamyona kaldırdılar.

meanings.en: to rise and fall repeatedly
meanings.exampleEn: His chest heaved as he caught his breath.
meanings.exampleTr: Nefesini toplarken göğsü inip kalkıyordu.

meanings.en: producing a deep, clear, continuing sound
meanings.exampleEn: The resonating sound of the bell filled the valley.
meanings.exampleTr: Çanın yankılanan sesi vadiyi doldurdu.

meanings.en: having a strong effect or meaning that people relate to
meanings.exampleEn: Her speech contained a deeply resonating message about hope.
meanings.exampleTr: Konuşması umut hakkında derinden iz bırakan bir mesaj içeriyordu.

meanings.en: treated with great respect, especially because of age, wisdom, or importance
meanings.exampleEn: He is a venerated figure among historians.
meanings.exampleTr: Tarihçiler arasında saygıyla anılan bir figürdür.

meanings.en: feeling or showing great respect and admiration
meanings.exampleEn: The crowd gazed at the singer with worshipful eyes.
meanings.exampleTr: Kalabalık şarkıcıya taparcasına bir bakışla baktı.

meanings.en: a series of pleasant thoughts that distract you from the present
meanings.exampleEn: She was lost in a daydream about her summer holiday.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaz tatiliyle ilgili bir hayale dalmıştı.

meanings.en: to have pleasant thoughts that make you stop paying attention
meanings.exampleEn: He often daydreams during boring lectures.
meanings.exampleTr: Sıkıcı derslerde sık sık hayal kurar.

meanings.en: to make someone or something feel or look young, fresh, or energetic again
meanings.exampleEn: A short holiday can rejuvenate both mind and body.
meanings.exampleTr: Kısa bir tatil hem zihni hem bedeni canlandırabilir.

meanings.en: to give new energy or strength to something
meanings.exampleEn: The new manager hopes to reinvigorate the struggling company.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni müdür, zor durumdaki şirketi yeniden canlandırmayı umuyor.

meanings.en: given new energy or strength
meanings.exampleEn: She returned to work reinvigorated after her vacation.
meanings.exampleTr: Tatilinden sonra işine yeniden canlanmış olarak döndü.

meanings.tr: çağrılı taşımacılık, uygulama üzerinden araç çağırma
meanings.en: relating to ordering a car and driver through a smartphone app
meanings.exampleEn: Ride-hailing services like Uber have transformed urban transport.
meanings.exampleTr: Uber gibi çağrılı taşımacılık hizmetleri kentsel ulaşımı dönüştürdü.

meanings.en: a loose outer piece of clothing without sleeves
meanings.exampleEn: She wrapped a long black cloak around her shoulders.
meanings.exampleTr: Omuzlarına uzun siyah bir pelerin sardı.

meanings.en: something that hides or covers something else
meanings.exampleEn: The meeting was held under a cloak of secrecy.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantı bir gizlilik perdesi altında yapıldı.

meanings.en: to hide or cover something
meanings.exampleEn: He tried to cloak his fear with a confident smile.
meanings.exampleTr: Korkusunu kendinden emin bir gülümsemeyle gizlemeye çalıştı.

meanings.en: solid or hollow tube-shaped objects with circular ends
meanings.exampleEn: The machine uses two metal cylinders to press the paper.
meanings.exampleTr: Makine kâğıdı preslemek için iki metal silindir kullanıyor.

meanings.en: the chambers in an engine where fuel is burned to produce power
meanings.exampleEn: The engine has six cylinders and runs very smoothly.
meanings.exampleTr: Motorun altı silindiri var ve çok sorunsuz çalışıyor.

meanings.en: small tube-shaped objects used to make hair curl
meanings.exampleEn: She sat with curlers in her hair before the party.
meanings.exampleTr: Partiden önce saçında bigudilerle oturuyordu.

meanings.en: noisy, energetic, and cheerful in a lively way
meanings.exampleEn: The children were boisterous and full of energy.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar gürültücü ve enerji doluydu.

meanings.en: unpleasantly loud and harsh
meanings.exampleEn: We could hear raucous laughter from the next room.
meanings.exampleTr: Yan odadan kulak tırmalayan kahkahalar duyabiliyorduk.

meanings.en: a rough, cruel, or violent person
meanings.exampleEn: He was a brute who bullied everyone around him.
meanings.exampleTr: Etrafındaki herkese zorbalık eden bir canavardı.

meanings.en: involving physical strength rather than thought
meanings.exampleEn: They used brute force to break down the door.
meanings.exampleTr: Kapıyı kırmak için kaba kuvvet kullandılar.

meanings.en: combined with oxygen, often causing rust or discolouration
meanings.exampleEn: The oxidized metal had turned a dull brown colour.
meanings.exampleTr: Oksitlenmiş metal donuk kahverengi bir renge dönmüştü.

meanings.en: to secretly try to destroy or weaken a system, authority, or belief
meanings.exampleEn: The group tried to subvert the government from within.
meanings.exampleTr: Grup hükümeti içeriden yıkmaya çalıştı.

meanings.en: the act of damaging or treating a holy or respected place with disrespect
meanings.exampleEn: The desecration of the ancient temple shocked the community.
meanings.exampleTr: Antik tapınağın tahrip edilmesi toplumu şoke etti.

meanings.en: a person who has done something morally or religiously wrong
meanings.exampleEn: The preacher urged every sinner to repent.
meanings.exampleTr: Vaiz her günahkârı tövbe etmeye çağırdı.

meanings.en: the quality of being violent, fierce, or intense
meanings.exampleEn: The storm struck the coast with terrifying ferocity.
meanings.exampleTr: Fırtına kıyıya korkunç bir şiddetle vurdu.

meanings.en: to move suddenly and quickly in a particular direction
meanings.exampleEn: A cat darted across the road in front of the car.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir kedi arabanın önünden yola fırladı.

meanings.en: a small pointed object thrown in the game of darts
meanings.exampleEn: He threw the dart and hit the bullseye.
meanings.exampleTr: Oku fırlattı ve tam ortayı vurdu.

meanings.en: to walk slowly and heavily, as if tired
meanings.exampleEn: The tired hikers plodded up the steep hill.
meanings.exampleTr: Yorgun yürüyüşçüler dik tepeyi ağır ağır çıktılar.

meanings.en: to work slowly and steadily at something dull
meanings.exampleEn: She plodded through the long report all afternoon.
meanings.exampleTr: Bütün öğleden sonra uzun raporu güçlükle bitirmeye çalıştı.

meanings.en: in a way that is small in amount and not enough
meanings.exampleEn: The workers were meagrely paid for their long hours.
meanings.exampleTr: İşçilere uzun çalışma saatleri için yetersizce ödeme yapıldı.
